name: Hermanos Reyes Auto Repair
hoursText: Monday-Friday: 8am to 6pm, Saturday: 8am to 2pm, Sunday: closed

profile.pricing: $95 diagnostic fee, waived if you approve the repair with us. Labor rate $120/hour. We always call with a written estimate before doing any work, and never do extra work without your OK.
profile.warranty: 12 months / 12,000 miles on parts and labor for most repairs. Used tires: 30-day warranty against defects.
profile.vehicles: Most cars, SUVs, minivans and light trucks: domestic, Japanese and Korean, including light-duty diesel pickups. We send out full transmission rebuilds, body and paint work, and most European luxury cars (BMW, Mercedes, Audi). No semis or RVs.
profile.towing: Call Westside Towing at (317) 555-0188 - mention us for a discounted tow to the shop. After hours, park it in the lot and drop the keys in the slot by the office door.
profile.waiting: You can wait for oil changes, tire work, flat repairs, battery replacement and most brake jobs - waiting room has wifi and coffee. For diagnostics and bigger repairs please drop the car off in the morning. After-hours key drop available.
profile.credentials: Family owned since 2009 by the Reyes brothers. ASE-certified technicians. Bilingual staff - se habla español.
profile.policies: We accept cash, all major cards, and Zelle. Financing on repairs over $500 through Snap Finance. Free brake inspections.
